notes: Apply equivalent headers in the selected host before public launch.
Tighten connect-src to the selected RPC and error-reporting endpoints after provider selection.
Do not add unsafe-inline for scripts; the current dashboard uses an inline script, so public deployment should move inline JavaScript to a local asset before enforcing this CSP.
